[***Journal of Economic Geography***]{.journal} · Accepted

\[[Working Paper](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1rgn5Rf4Eb_GaWoT8MnpNouMwsupganI-/view?usp=sharing)\] · \[[Media coverage](../media.qmd)\]

> *This paper analyzes the shares of high-income earners within local populations, leveraging consistent annual income distributions for 90 French regions since 1960. The spatial dispersion of these shares has followed a U-shaped trajectory: a high concentration level in the 1960s, a decline in subsequent decades, and a marked increase since the early 2000s. We demonstrate that shifts in regional productive structures explain this U-shaped trajectory.*
